name: qdrant
description: Give the agent a long-term, semantically searchable memory backed by Qdrant through the official Qdrant MCP server. Store free-form text (notes, code snippets, documents, conversations) and retrieve it by meaning, not by exact keyword. Embeddings are produced locally with FastEmbed. Works with Qdrant Cloud, a self-hosted Qdrant cluster, or a local on-disk Qdrant database.

interface.shortDescription: Semantic memory and vector search backed by the official Qdrant MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Qdrant skill exposes the official `mcp-server-qdrant` as a single Fractal toolset. It turns a Qdrant cluster (Qdrant Cloud, self-hosted, or local on-disk) into a long-term semantic memory that the agent can write to (`qdrant-store`) and read from (`qdrant-find`) using cosine similarity, not exact keyword match. Embeddings are produced locally through FastEmbed, so no external embedding API is required. Default model is `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2`; configurable through `EMBEDDING_MODEL`. Supports read-only deployments (`QDRANT_READ_ONLY=true`), custom collection names, and per-workload tool descriptions for code-search, document-search, ticket-search, and similar RAG setups. The collection declared in `COLLECTION_NAME` is auto-created on first use, so the toolset is safe to launch against an empty cluster.
defaultPrompt: Use the Qdrant skill whenever the user wants the agent to remember something across sessions, recall prior context by meaning, or build a semantic / RAG search over their own data.
Store natural-language summaries in `information` and structured side-data in `metadata`; chunk long documents before persisting them.
Prefer the configured default collection (`COLLECTION_NAME`) and pin `EMBEDDING_MODEL` to keep stored vectors consistent across runs.
